data.title: Can Bitcoin Still Reach $1 Million by 2035?
data.description: Bitcoin has slid more than half from its peak, ETF money is leaving, and the Fed keeps tightening. Yet bulls still cling to a seven-figure dream, and one checkpoint in 2027 could decide whether it survives.
